resources.string: Check that your PC shows the same code:
Pairing didn\'t finish. Try again on your PC.
Veyl connects directly to your PC on your local network. Sound stays between your devices.
Veyl needs local network access to connect to your PC.
Connect this phone and your PC to the same network.
Veyl couldn\'t save paired devices. Try again.
Veyl couldn\'t load paired devices. Try again.
Tap Start in Veyl on your phone.
This app doesn\'t share its sound with Veyl. Try YouTube, YouTube Music, the Veyl player or the test sound.
Play some music or a video on your phone.
Another app is using your phone\'s microphone.
Turn the volume down a little. The sound is distorting.
This track has few high sounds. A brighter song works better.
This track has many quiet moments.
The echo is unclear. Keep the phone\'s speaker and microphones uncovered.
Sudden noises near the phone make the echo hard to read.
